title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: breakout room support
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's supplied notice, including the revised December rollout and availability by default. The PowerShell control and product licensing are documented, and the remaining Android-specific gaps are appropriately qualified.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Scope
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to let meeting organisers assign Teams Rooms on Android devices to breakout rooms.
claims.quote: Meeting organizers will be able to assign Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android devices to breakout rooms.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure and Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Organisers can move the device between breakout rooms and the main meeting room during a meeting.
claims.quote: This update allows Teams Rooms on Android devices to be assigned to breakout rooms and moved between breakout rooms and the main meeting room by meeting organizers.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The included licensing model refers to the Teams Rooms Basic or Pro product licence already required for the device.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices should only be assigned Teams Rooms Basic or Teams Rooms Pro licenses (Teams Rooms legacy licenses are also valid).

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn says centrally managed Teams Rooms devices should be assigned Teams Rooms Pro or Teams Rooms Basic licences.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices managed by central IT should only be assigned the following licenses: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro, Microsoft Teams Rooms Basic, and any additional licenses required for calling (such as calling plans) or enhanced security.

claims.claim: Learn allows additional licences required for calling or enhanced security.
claims.quote: and any additional licenses required for calling (such as calling plans) or enhanced security.

claims.claim: The licensing page includes an Android device and connected touch console as a Teams Rooms system.
claims.quote:
A Teams Rooms system can be one of the following:
- A Teams Rooms on Android device and touch console connected via either an IP-based or USB connection

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing

claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams Rooms Android breakout rooms support app version prerequisites license Basic Pro role setting' and '"Teams Rooms on Android" "breakout" settings disable license'; opened Rooms licensing, device comparison and release notes; no feature-specific licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost

claims.claim: No additional prerequisite specific to Android breakout-room support is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Teams Rooms on Android" "breakout" prerequisites role'; opened device comparison and Rooms release notes and read supplied MC1488847; no additional Android feature prerequisite.

claims.claim: No minimum app version for Android breakout-room support is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Teams Rooms on Android" "breakout" "version"'; read certified-device firmware search excerpts and searched Rooms release notes for breakout rooms; matches concern Windows and state no Android minimum version.

claims.claim: No Android-feature-specific administrative role prerequisite is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Teams Rooms on Android" "breakout" prerequisites role'; read results, device comparison, Rooms release notes and MC1488847; organisers perform the meeting action, but no Android-specific administrative role is named.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowBreakoutRooms $false disables breakout-room functionality in the selected meeting policy.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy
    [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>]
    [-AllowBreakoutRooms <Boolean>]
Set to true to enable Breakout Rooms, set to false to disable the Breakout Rooms functionality.

claims.claim: No Teams admin center setting for AllowBreakoutRooms is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'AllowBreakoutRooms Teams admin center PowerShell only breakout rooms Android participation policy'; opened settings-policies-reference, which lists AllowBreakoutRooms under 'PowerShell-only audio & video meeting policies'; no UI setting found.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: AllowBreakoutRooms defaults to True.
claims.quote:
| Parameter | Default | Description |
| AllowBreakoutRooms | True | This setting enables the Breakout Rooms functionality. |

claims.where: controls[0].governs and scope; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The meeting policy controls breakout-room functionality for users assigned the policy.
claims.quote:
The Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet allows administrators to update existing meeting policies that can be assigned to particular users to control Teams features related to meetings.
Set to true to enable Breakout Rooms, set to false to disable the Breakout Rooms functionality.

claims.claim: Learn does not describe whether AllowBreakoutRooms specifically controls Android room-device participation.
claims.quote: Searched: 'AllowBreakoutRooms Teams admin center PowerShell only breakout rooms Android participation policy'; read Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy parameter and settings reference; neither specifies room-device participation or Android assignment behaviour.

claims.claim: MC1488847 does not describe autonomous action by the room device.
claims.quote: Searched: full supplied MC1488847 for automatic or autonomous device actions; it assigns room movement to meeting organisers and describes default availability, not autonomous device behaviour.
